title: Capability Schema
description: A bounded operational permission: 'what may this subject do?' (Vol 1 §14; Vol 2 §11-14; Vol 10). A capability is NOT identity, ownership, or trustworthiness. Capabilities MUST have explicit scope (Vol 2 §28 Invariant 1) - so issuer, holder, action, and scope are required; time-bounding (expiration) is strongly recommended (a missing expiration warns, Vol 2 §6/§13). Enforced by TOOLS/lore_validate.py Check 4.

issuer.description: object-ref/authority id that granted the capability.

holder.description: object-ref id of the subject that holds it.

scope.description: the bounded target/scope, e.g. /production/api/users (globbing, not SQL-wildcards; Vol 2 §16-17).

expiration.description: capability lifecycle end; strongly recommended (least privilege / time-bounded).

delegated_from.description: object-ref id of the parent capability, if delegated. A delegated capability MUST NOT exceed its parent (Vol 2 §21) - lineage made explicit (invariant 11).
